records.printed_date_context: 22 November 1918, under nominal seven-part header XYZ v LP (03.54 p.m.)

model.qualification: The frame and borrowed tail are conditional on a same-intended-ciphertext-copy relationship with p218 A2. They do not correct the printed date.

notes: The 160 observed source coordinates are not padded by a medical-text guess. A separate 284-coordinate printed witness supplies the tail.
The shared prefix has 157 exact glyph agreements, two conflicting valid coordinates, and one valid p212 coordinate where p218 prints a dash.
RUSZLAND is retained as received. Only the remaining JNNEREN word is locally repaired in the final candidate.
No published key or historical date is changed.

copy_assumption.evidence: 157 identical observed coordinates in a 160-coordinate aligned prefix; matching 284 advertised lengths; the p218 full witness under the stated key yields coherent German.
copy_assumption.not_proven: Whether the p212 block was historically transmitted on 22 November, misdated, or misplaced during compilation. The complete nominal medical message is not reconstructed.

corpus_search.normalization: Join OCR groups in each block; only all-ADFGVX windows are indexed. Do not bridge separate OCR blocks.
corpus_search.limit: A failure to share an exact ten-coordinate window does not exclude a differently enciphered copy, heavy OCR/source corruption or an unmodelled frame.

prior_attribution.earlier_full_body: p218 A2 already appears in experiments/corpus_readings and the reading catalog. Its existing attribution and prior repairs remain unchanged.
prior_attribution.contribution: A newly recognized truncated physical copy, complementary source witnesses for earlier repairs, and conditional recovery of a missing tail from the already edited full witness. No new unique historical message or first decipherment is claimed.
